name: Stockholm Syndrome
review:
Stockholm Syndrome is a heist slot on a 3-4-3-4-3 grid with 432 ways. Winning symbols explode and new ones fall in. A Con Man Wild landing fully on reel 3 unlocks the bottom position of that reel and adds a character symbol.

xBomb Wilds, Infectious xWays, xNudge and Reel xSplit all appear. Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with a 28,873x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
